# OpenRemoTV

> OpenRemoTV is a free, open-source (MIT) Android phone app that remotes, debloats and restyles Android TV, Google TV
> and Fire TV over Wi-Fi with ADB, without root. It disables preinstalled bloatware (never uninstalls it), backs up
> first, can undo everything with one tap, and installs an optional manga-style or India-themed TV home screen.

Key facts:
- Works on Android TV and Google TV devices running Android 8 or newer, and on Fire TV for debloating.
- Debloating uses `pm disable-user --user 0`, so every app can be turned back on. Apps the TV needs are locked.
- Ships tested debloat lists for 260 TV models (from the cleanyourtv project) plus a common list.
- Phone features: remote with typing, open TV apps, send YouTube links, photos, videos and files, sweep, check.
- Home screens: MangaHome (a comic page with the mascot Remo) and IndiaMinimalist (photos of India, Panchang).
- Languages: English and Hindi. No accounts, no analytics, no ads.
- Install: download the APK from the GitHub releases page; turn on network debugging on the TV.
